description:
Create a new organizational group in ArkCase. Log in as arkcase-admin@dev.arkcase.com (password: ArkCase1234!). Navigate to the Admin module (Administration), find the Groups management section, and create a new group. 

Group Details:
- Name: 'FOIA_Senior_Analysts'
- Description: 'Senior FOIA analysts with elevated review permissions'
- Supervisor: 'arkcase-admin'

Ensure the group is saved and appears in the list.
